# 🍄 Madness in Wonderland 🎩

## Day 1 — The Tumble Down

The fall takes longer than it should.

You remember the mirror — your bedroom mirror, the one that had been *wrong* for weeks, rippling when no one was looking, showing reflections that moved a half-second too late. And then it opened, and you reached in, and the world turned *inside out*.

You land softly on a carpet of enormous mushrooms — spongy, luminescent, the color of bruised plums and sunset. The air smells of petrichor, old tea, and something sweetly impossible, like the memory of birthday cake.

🌿 **The Tulgey Wood** stretches around you in every direction. The trees here don't grow *up* so much as they grow *enthusiastically* — sideways, in spirals, through each other. Their leaves are playing cards: hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades, fluttering in a breeze that doesn't seem to exist. A path of cracked yellow cobblestones winds away in three directions, each fork marked by a crooked signpost.

You are not alone.

**Hatter Madigan** sits cross-legged nearby, examining an enormous pocket watch with an expression of profound betrayal. He taps it. Shakes it. Holds it to his ear.

*"Still six o'clock,"* he mutters. *"It has been six o'clock for — well, I've lost count, which is rather the problem when you've lost TIME, isn't it? Oh!"* His green eyes snap to you, and something clears in them. Recognition. Wonder. *"Oh. Oh my. It's YOU. The little girl who was kind. Except you're not little anymore, are you? How terribly rude of you to have grown."* He beams. 🎩

**Warren Hastings** pops up from behind a mushroom, enormous ears swiveling like satellite dishes. His pink eyes are wide with alarm — his default state. He clutches his golden pocket watch and checks it frantically.

*"Oh dear, oh DEAR — we're late, we're dreadfully late! Or possibly early. Time is rather... unreliable here. Frightfully sorry, miss, but —"* He squints at you, adjusts his rumpled red waistcoat. *"Did you... fall? Through the mirror? Oh. Oh no. That means SHE knows. The Queen always knows when someone comes through."* His ears flatten. 🐇

Nearby, a wide, luminous grin materializes in midair between two branches, followed slowly by the rest of **Cheshire** — striped purple and pink, draped across a branch like a silk scarf, golden eyes half-lidded.

*"Well, well. A girl who fell once... has fallen again."* His tail curls into a question mark. *"Tell me, Alice — did you come back because you remembered? Or because you forgot?"* 🐱

**Duchess Pepper** is here too, leaning against an enormous spotted toadstool, her massive pepper grinder planted in the dirt like a battle standard. She gives you a grin that shows gold-capped tusks.

*"The MORAL of falling through mirrors,"* she announces to no one in particular, *"is that the world on the OTHER side always needs you more than the one you LEFT!"* She sneezes — and three nearby mushrooms turn briefly plaid. ✨

**Absalom** is conspicuously perched atop the largest mushroom, wreathed in shimmering hookah smoke. He has not moved. He may not have moved in *decades*. His amber eyes drift slowly — *so slowly* — toward you.

*"Who..."* A long exhale of iridescent smoke. *"...are..."* Another pause. *"...you?"* 🐛

---

The three signpost forks read:

🪧 **LEFT** → *"The Mad Tea Party — 2 miles (or possibly 2 minutes, hard to say)"*
🪧 **STRAIGHT** → *"The Crossroads of Hearts — turn back while you can"*
🪧 **RIGHT** → *"The Mushroom Heights — mind your head (and your size)"*

Behind you, the Tulgey Wood grows thicker and darker. Strange sounds echo from its depths — birdsong played backwards, laughter with no source, and the distant *snicker-snack* of something with very large jaws. 🦷

---

**What do you do, Alice?** The whole of Wonderland lies before you. 🗺️
I guess I sing and dance
I give 1 gp to all my friends.
A generous start to an adventure! Let me update the gold for everyone.
Alice has 15 gp and 5 companions — that's 5 gp given away. Let me update everyone's gold.

You fish into your belt pouch and press a shiny gold coin into each of your companions' hands. 💰

**Hatter Madigan** holds the coin up to the light, turns it over three times, and tucks it into his waistcoat with a little bow. *"How wonderfully generous! I shall buy myself some time with it. Oh wait — you can't BUY time, can you? I tried once. He was very offended."* 🎩

**Warren** clutches the coin to his chest, ears perking straight up. *"For — for ME? But I haven't done anything yet! Oh dear, this creates a terrible obligation — I really MUST be useful now, mustn't I?"* He tucks it away with trembling paws and checks his watch. 🐇

**Cheshire** doesn't appear to take the coin so much as the coin simply *ceases to be in your hand and begins to be in his*. His grin widens. *"How curious. A gift given freely... is worth more than a gift earned. Or is it the other way round? I can never remember which way the morals go."* 🐱

**Absalom** regards the coin resting on his palm for a very, very long time. *"...Interesting."* That's it. That's all you get. He pockets it. 🐛

And then there's **Duchess Pepper**. 🎶

She takes her coin, bites it to test its authenticity (half-orc habit), and then — seized by the spirit of the moment — slams her pepper grinder into the dirt like a staff, throws her head back, and *belts out a song*.

*"🎵 SPEAK ROUGHLY to your little boy, and BEAT him when he SNEEZES! He only does it to ANNOY, because he KNOWS it — 🎵"*

She spins on her heel, grabs Warren by the paws, and whirls him into an involuntary waltz across the mushroom clearing. The harengon's ears flap wildly as his feet leave the ground on every other turn.

*"Oh dear oh DEAR oh —"* Warren squeaks.

*"DANCE, rabbit! The moral of DANCING is that your FEET know things your HEAD never will!"*

The card-leaf trees rustle in what might be applause. Somewhere in the canopy, a bread-and-butterfly flutters past, trailing crumbs. Even Absalom's hookah smoke curls into little spiraling dancers for a moment before dissolving.

Cheshire watches from his branch, tail swaying in time. *"She dances like she fights,"* he purrs. *"With her whole self. It's either wonderful or dangerous. Possibly both."*

The Hatter begins clapping along — slightly off-beat, naturally — and produces a teacup from absolutely nowhere. ☕

---

💰 **Gold update:** Alice 10 gp → (gave 5 gp, 1 to each companion)

The three signposts still beckon ahead. The backwards birdsong in the Tulgey Wood behind you grows a touch louder. And somewhere, distantly, a trumpet sounds — three sharp notes, like a herald announcing something to no one.

Warren's ears snap toward the sound. His dancing stops. His face goes pale beneath his white fur.

*"...That's a royal trumpet,"* he whispers. *"Card-soldiers. Patrolling."*

**What do you do?** 🃏
